svg.title: Page 1 — Campaign, full desktop layout
svg.desc: The default view in four rows, read top-left to bottom-right as what we are looking for, how far we have got, how the loop is running, and what it found: mission, campaign and agent-and-critic cards; the full-width discovery-loop funnel; the composition-space map beside the live agent feed; and the top-candidates table beside the lab-notebook panel.

g.text: Loop closes through the lab notebook — the next iteration starts from a fresh context and reads what this one learned.
